name: outbound-reply-guard
label: Outbound reply guard
description: Backstops the Gmail confirm surface at the platform layer, for EVERY caller. The send-outcome intent only ever runs from the operator-confirmed Send reply action, but the Gmail send_message tool exists whenever the connection is loaded, and a future intent (or the chat agent) could call it. This preToolUse hook fires on any send_message, resolves the recipient to a submission via broker_email, and blocks the send when that submission has no saved risk finding (i.e. it was never triaged). So 'no reply before a decision' is true platform-wide, not just inside one handler. Capability gate (store:read) + verified caller are platform-supplied, while the policy (the rule) is the author's, owned here.
